note: Homepage 'What's happening at Everest' wall. One object per initiative; add a new one by copying an existing object. Put the lead story first and give it "featured": true (only one item should be featured). Dates are YYYY-MM-DD in New Zealand time, and they drive the status tag automatically: "status" shows before startDate, "liveStatus" from startDate, "doneStatus" after endDate, and the card disappears after hideAfter. Leave a date as null if it does not apply. "theme" is one of: empower, performance, upcoming (use upcoming for anything still in development). "ctaHref" must be a page that already exists on the site. If you replace an image, give the new file a new name, because /assets/ is cached permanently. "_todo" is never shown on the site. IMPORTANT: this file is publicly readable at /data/whats-happening.json, so only add initiatives that are confirmed and partners who have agreed to be named. Never park drafts here.

items.title: EMPOWER Youth Pilot
items.description: Everest is launching the EMPOWER pilot, a youth movement and confidence program designed to help young people build strength, coordination, self-belief and positive habits through structured physical activity.

items.title: Built For The Climb
items.description: Local firefighters are using Everest training to prepare for upcoming Combat Challenge events and the annual Sky Tower Challenge. Built For The Climb supports the strength, conditioning and resilience needed for demanding emergency-service performance.
